name: plan_j_cormeilles
label: The plan, line J by Cormeilles to Nord-Est
about: Line J trains no longer end at the surface of Saint-Lazare: they use the underground platforms of RER F and run on to Nord-Est in 4 minutes, in the room RER F leaves in its tunnel (23 trains an hour for a limit of 32). Where they turn or run on beyond Nord-Est is left open (ASSUMPTION: they end at Nord-Est). The 9 trains an hour of the branch by Cormeilles-en-Parisis (Pontoise, Gisors, Conflans).
